node.label: Absence of peroxisomes
node.definition: Lack of observable peroxisomes. This feature can be observed by immunohistochemical staining of cultured cells (such as fibroblasts) or by electronmicroscopy.

evidence.snippet: Peroxisome biogenesis disorder 4A (Zellweger): Absence of peroxisomes (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
